newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland's Alltracel buys Franklin Pharmaceuticals.
newsitem.headline: Ireland's Alltracel buys Franklin Pharmaceuticals.

text.p: Ireland's Alltracel Pharmaceuticals said on Tuesday it planned to buy County Meath-based Franklin Pharmaceuticals Ltd in an investment and acquisition package worth 4.5 million Irish pounds.

Alltracel said it planned to upgrade Franklin, which will be used to develop and produce its blood coagulant range of medical devices. The upgrade will create 60 new jobs initially. Franklin currently employs 20 people.
Alltracel said earlier this month it planned to list on London's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) in early June with a market capitalisation of 40 million pounds sterling.
